description: This file defines a class UriForLocationHeaderSupplier that provides the URI for the Location header in HTTP responses when a resource is created. It constructs the URI by manipulating the request URI, entity ID, and command response details.

classes.name: UriForLocationHeaderSupplier
classes.description: Provides the URI for the location header of HTTP responses after resource creation, handling query string removal and entity ID management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Constructs and returns the appropriate URI for the Location header based on the HTTP request and command response.

methods.name: isRequestIdempotent
methods.description: Determines whether the HTTP request method is idempotent.

methods.name: removeEntityId
methods.description: Removes the entity ID portion from the request URI if present.

methods.name: getIndexOfEntityId
methods.description: Finds the position of the entity ID within the request URI.

methods.name: removeTrailingSlash
methods.description: Removes a trailing slash from the URI string if present.

methods.name: getLocationUriString
methods.description: Builds the full location URI string using the request URI, entity ID, and resource path.
